mentions.name: Plantshare
mentions.description: A free mobile app (Android and iOS) where gardeners share plants, cuttings, and free stuff with each other. Listings marked 'for sale' are being moved out of the main section to keep the focus on free sharing, and a web front end is being considered in addition to the existing mobile apps.
mentions.problem: Plants marked 'for sale' were cluttering the main section and getting in the way of sharing free plants and cuttings.

mentions.name: Plantshare
mentions.description: A free app that helps gardeners share plants with other local gardeners. Since gardeners' plants often propagate on their own, the app lets them share those plants and see what others nearby are sharing. It is in a working beta on Android and iOS, with a possible web front end later.
mentions.problem: The author couldn't find an app for sharing locally propagated plants with nearby gardeners, so built the one they wanted.
mentions.audience: Gardeners looking to share plants with other local gardeners.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on Plantshare, a free app that aims to help gardeners share plants with other local gardeners.
